summary: Mountain biker crashed in the desert near 29 Road, Grand Junction; reported missing by family about 7:00 p.m. after failing to return home; about a dozen Mesa County SAR members searched several hours by ATV, located him, and CareFlight was dispatched; injuries not life-threatening.
notes: INSERT run1004; source is a verbatim RadioReference forum repost of the KREX News story by Matt Kroschel (created May 16, 2011 9:50 PM MDT); KREX original URL not recoverable. Date pinned by story timestamp + "Monday night" search.
